reader_summary.headline: On today's show.
reader_summary.overview: On today's show, we'll discuss a continuing empty room – an opportunity ignored by most investors because they either don't want to or can't participate. We've shared conversations under the theme about investing in Venezuela, Africa, CLO equity, tax assets, and biotech. Among them, biotech is a room that just keeps getting emptier, so I thought it would be fun to pay it another visit.

key_points.text: Rod Wong is the founder and Managing Partner of RTW Investments.
I had a chance to drop by Rod's office in NYC and discuss his background, case for life sciences, investment and business approach.
